reviewItem.question: Does "Ignoring resource updates configured in `ignoreDifferences` by default: By default, the existing system-level `ignoreDifferences` customizations will be added…" mean a change to config-key:argo-cd|path=resource.compareoptions.ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates|component=argocd-cm (default-changed)?

proposed.statement: In 3.0 the system-level ignoreDifferences customizations also apply to ignoring resource updates by default (ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates now true); set it to false in argocd-cm resource.compareoptions to keep the v2 behavior.
